results.reason: Made of rigid plastic casing, though dismantling the ink reservoir and spring is needed before recycling.
reuse_ideas: Refill the ink cartridge instead of discarding
Use the plastic barrel as a plant stake or marker
Cut down into small rings for craft projects
where_to_dispose: E-waste or hard plastic collection drive
results.local_tip: Separate the ink refill from the plastic body and hand it over to your local MCD waste collector in the dry waste stream.
